verses.en: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
verses.sm: UA fetalai ane foi o ia ia te i latou, E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o loo tutū mai nisi iinei, e le oo ia te i latou le oti, seia latou vaaia le malo o le Atua ona oo mai ma le mana.

verses.en: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
verses.sm: Ua mavae aso e ono, ona o ai lea o Iesu ma Peteru, ma Iakopo, ma Ioane; ua ia avae ia te I latou i le mauga maualuga, ua na o i latou lava; ona liua lea o ia i o latou luma.

verses.en: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
verses.sm: Ua pupula ona ofu, ua matuā pa‘epa‘e lava pei o le kiona; e leai foi se tagata taofu i le lalolagi na te mafaia ona faasinasina faapena.

verses.en: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.sm: Ua faaali mai foi ia te i latou o Elia ma Mose ; ua fetautalatala‘i i latou ma Iesu.

verses.en: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Peteru ia Iesu, ua faapea mai, Rapi e, e lelei ina tatou nonofo iinei; se‘i matou faia foi ni fale apitaga se tolu; o le tasi mo oe, o le tasi mo Mose, o le tasi mo Elia.

verses.en: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
verses.sm: Auā ua ia le iloa se upu e fai atu, ina ua matautuia i latou.

verses.en: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.sm: Ua oo mai foi le ao ua ufitia ai i latou ; ona tūlei mai lea o le siufofoga mai le ao, ua faapea mai, O lo‘u Atalii pele lena, ina faalogo ia outou ia te ia.

verses.en: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
verses.sm: Ona faafuasei lea ona vaavaai solo o i latou, ua le toe iloa se tasi, ua na o Iesu lava ma i latou.

verses.en: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
verses.sm: Ua o ifo i latou i le mauga, ona vavao atu lea o ia ia te i latou, ne‘i latou ta‘u atu i se tasi o mea sa latou vaaia, seia tu mai le Atalii o le tagata nai e ua oti.

verses.en: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
verses.sm: Ona latou taofi ai lea i lea upu, ma fesueai, pe se a le toe tu mai nai e ua oti.

verses.en: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.sm: Ona latou fesili lea ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Se a le mea e fai mai ai le au tusiupu, e ao ona muai sau o Elia ?

verses.en: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o ia, ua faapea atu ai ia te i latou, E lua‘i sau lava Elia, ma toe fuatai mea uma; pei ona tusia foi i le Atalii o le tagata, e tiga o ia i mea e tele, e inosia foi o ia.

verses.en: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
verses.sm: A ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua mavae ona sau o Elia, ua latou faia foi ia te ia mea uma na latou loto i ai, pei ona tusia ia te ia.

verses.en: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu ia i le au soo, ona silasila atu lea i le motu o tagata e toatele ua vagaia i latou, ma le au tusiupu ua fesilisili ia te i latou.

verses.en: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
verses.sm: Ua iloa o ia e le motu o tagata uma, ona taufaiofo loa ai lea o i latou, ua latou taufetuli mai, ma fealofani ma ia.

verses.en: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
verses.sm: Ua fesili foi o ia i le au . tusiupu, Pe se a se mea tou te fesili ai ia te i latou?

verses.en: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o le tasi o le motu o tagata,ua faapea . mai, Le a‘oa‘o e, ua ou au mai ia te oe lo‘u atalii ua i ai le agaga gūgū ;

verses.en: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
verses.sm: so se mea e pue ai ia te ia, ona lafotu ai lea ia te ia , ua fāuā le gutu, . ua lilivau ona nifo, ua tino vale ai foi o ia; ua uma foi ona ou fai atu i ou soo ina ia latou tulia o ia, a ua le mafaia e i latou.

verses.en: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o ia ia te ia, ua faapea atu, Le tupulaga le faatuatua e, tatou te i ai ma outou seia afea? ou te faapalepale ia te outou seia afea ? ina au mai ia o ia ia te au.

verses.en: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
verses.sm: Ona latou aumaia lea o ia ia te ia ; ua na iloa o ia, ona faataafiti loa lea ia te ia e ]e agaga, i le ua paū ia i le eleele, ona taafilifili ai lea o ia, ma fāuā lona gutu.

verses.en: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
verses.sm: Ona fesili atu lea o ia i lona tamā, Talu mai anafea ona oo o lena mea ia te ia ? Ūa fai mai o ia, Talu ina o tama itiiti.

verses.en: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
verses.sm: Ua lafo soo foi o ia ia te ia i le afi, atoa ma le vai ina ia fano ai o ia ; a e peitai, ai se mea e te mafaia, ia e alofa mai ia te i matou, ma ia e fesoasoani mai ia te i matou.

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
verses.sm: Ona fetaiai atu lea o Iesu ia te ia, Afai ua e mafaia ona faatuatua, e mafaia mea uma lava i le faatuatua.

verses.en: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
verses.sm: Ona alaga loa lea o le tamā o le tama, ua fai mai ma le tagi, Le Alii e, ua ou faatuatua; ia e ft soasoani i lo‘u le faatuatua.

verses.en: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
verses.sm: Ua silafia e Iesu ua taufetuli mai le motu o tagata, ona vavao atu lea o ia i le agaga leaga, ua faapea atu ia te ia, O oe na, le agaga gūgū ma le tutuli, ou te fai atu lava ia te oe, ina e alu i fafo ia te ia, aua foi e te toe alu i totonu ia te ia.

verses.en: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
verses.sm: Ona alaga lea o le agaga, ma faataafiti tele ia te ia, ona alu lea i fafo; ona liua lea o ia peiseai ua oti; ona fai mai ai lea tagata e toatele, Ua oti lava ia.

verses.en: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
verses.sm: A o Iesu ua tago ifo ia i lona lima, ma faatu ia te ia, ona tulai lea ia.

verses.en: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.sm: Ua maliu ane Iesu i le fale, ona fesili lea o ona soo ia te ia ina ua na o i latou, Se a le mea na matou le mafai ai ona tulia o ia ?

verses.en: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, Ua na o le tatalo ma le anapogi e mafai ai ona 5 ese o mea faapena.

verses.en: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
verses.sm: Ua tuua foi e i latou lena mea, ua ui ane i Kalilaia ; o lona finagalo foi ina ia le iloa o ia e se tasi.

verses.en: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
verses.sm: Auā ua ia a‘oa‘o atu i ona soo, ma fetalai atu ia te i latou, Ua tuuina atu le Atalii o le tagata i lima o tagata, latou te fasioti foi ia te ia; a uma foi ona fasia o ia, e toe tu mai o ia i le aso tolu.

verses.en: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
verses.sm: A o i latou ua le iloa lea upu, ua matatau foi e fesili ia te ia.

verses.en: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
verses.sm: Ua oo ia i Kapanaumi, sa i le fale, ona fesili lea o ia ia te i latou; Pe se a na outou fefinauai ai i le ala ?

verses.en: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
verses.sm: A o i latou ua faalologo ; auā sa latou fefinauai i le ala po o ai so latou e sili ?

verses.en: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
verses.sm: Ua nofo ia i lalo, oua valaau atu lea i le toatinoagafulu ma le toalua, ua fetalai atu ia te i latou, Afai e fia muamua se tasi, e avea o ia ma mulimuli i tagata uma, ma auauna a tagata uma.

verses.en: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
verses.sm: Ona tago leā o ia i le tama itiiti, ua faatu ia te ia i o latou luma ; ua nā siitia o ia i ona lima, ona fetalai atu lea ia te i latou,

verses.en: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
verses.sm: Ai se talia se tarna itiiti faapenei i lo‘u nei igoa, ua talia e ia o a‘u; ai se talia a‘u, e le o a‘u ua ia talia, a o ia na auina mai a‘u.

verses.en: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Ioane ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Le a‘oa‘o e, na matou iloa le tasi ua tutuli temoni i lou suafa, ua ia le mulimuli mai ia te i tatou; na matou vaoia o ia, auā ua ia le mulimuli mai ia te i tatou.

verses.en: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu Iesu, Aua le vaoia o ia; auā e leai se tagata na te faia se vavega i lo‘u nei igoa, na te mafaia ona vave tautala i se upu leaga ia te au.

verses.en: For he that is not against us is on our part.
verses.sm: Auā foi o le le ‘au ese ia te i tatou, e ‘au faatasi lea ma i tatou.

verses.en: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
verses.sm: O se na te avatua foi se ipu vai ia te outou i lo‘u nei igoa, auā e o Keriso outou; e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e le māumau ia te ia lona taui.

verses.en: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
verses.sm: Ai se na te faatausuaiina se tasi o i latou nei e faatauvaa o e faatuatua mai ia te au, e lelei ia te ia pe ana noatia se maamoana.

verses.en: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
verses.sm: A faatausuaiina foi oe e lou lima, ina tutū ese ia; e lelei ona e sao i le ola a ua e lima mutu, a e leaga ona lima lua, a e alu i Kena, i le afi e le mafai ona tineia;

verses.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.sm: o i ai e le mamate o latou ilo, e le tineia foi le afi.

verses.en: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
verses.sm: A faatausuaiina foi oe e lou vae, ina tutū ese ia; e lelei ina e sao i le ola ua pipili, a e leaga ona lua ni vae, a e lafoina oe i Kena, i le afi e le mafai ona tineia ;

verses.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.sm: o i ai e le mamate o latou ilo, e le tineia foi le afi.

verses.en: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
verses.sm: A faatausuaiina foi oe e lou mata, ina sali ese ia; e lelei ina e sao i le malo o le Atua ma le mata e tasi, a e leaga ona lafoina oe ma ou mata e lua i le afi o Kena;

verses.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.sm: o i ai e le mamate o latou ilo, e le tineia foi le afi.

verses.en: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
verses.sm: Auā e taitasi uma ma faamasimaina i le afi, e taitasi foi taulaga uma ma faamasimaina i le masima.

verses.en: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
verses.sm: O le mea lelei le masima, a e afai e magalo le masima, se a se mea tou te faamāi aū ? Ia ia te outou le masima, ma ia fifilemu outou ia te outou. E sa ona aleia o le ava ; o le alofa o
